Inside This Book

Everything you need to turn
the fairway into your boardroom

The Wealth Caddie Framework
A practical system for turning every round of golf into a real wealth-building opportunity. Not theory. A repeatable framework built from lived experience, real conversations, and real outcomes.
The Four Relationship Types
Learn how to recognize who in your golf network is a mentor, a strategic peer, a referral source, or a future partner, and how those relationships can shape your next move.
The Five Laws of Abundance
The mindset behind the strategy. This section connects identity, abundance, and access so you can stop shrinking in powerful spaces and start moving with more intention.
Playing in Rooms They Did Not Build
A direct conversation about what it costs to show up in spaces that were not designed with you in mind, and how to keep showing up anyway with clarity, excellence, and power.
The 90-Day Wealth Caddie Plan
A simple plan for your first ninety days. Specific rounds. Specific relationships. Specific next moves. This is where inspiration turns into action.
The Legacy Shot
A final chapter about building something that outlives you and making the path clearer for the women coming behind you.
About the Author
Dr. Tasha McCray, PhD

Dr. Tasha McCray is a bestselling author, entrepreneur, real estate investor, nurse, and founder of TMac Inspired & CompliTrst, Inc. She has spent decades building across industries and now brings that lived experience into a new conversation about golf, wealth, and access.

She discovered golf during one of the hardest seasons of her life and found that the course held far more than a game. It held proximity, relationships, strategy, and a different kind of room. She is based in Tampa, Florida with her husband Benny.
